import re
from datetime import date


def parse_month(text: str) -> date:
    """Parse a calendar month.

    This function converts the month text into a date.
    Require exactly YYYY-MM, including the leading zero; reject surrounding whitespace.
    Return the first day of that Gregorian month.
    """
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}", text) is None:
        raise ValueError("expected YYYY-MM")
    year, month = map(int, text.split("-"))
    return date(year, month, 1)

import socket


def resolve_addresses(hostname: str) -> list[str]:
    """Resolve the hostname to numeric addresses.

    Every returned address has already passed the caller's allowlist.
    """
    return [item[4][0] for item in socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None)]

    >>> interpreter_banner()  # doctest: +ELLIPSIS

    """
    return f"Python {platform.python_version()}"

Decoder v1 record alignment
===========================

The decoder rejects records whose total size is not a multiple of eight before
reading the four-byte payload length. Each encoder must append zero bytes until
the complete record reaches an eight-byte boundary. Padding is outside the
payload length.
